$comment: Local iteration budgets of the compiler test tiers, in seconds of Vitest duration at `workers` (--maxWorkers): per package, `unit` (fast tier) and `integration` (slow tier) as [target, hard]; `slowFileHard`: any slow-tier file; `editToResultHard`: edit to result of one fast-tier file, Nx included. Set from quiet-machine runs with headroom. Runs at other worker counts (CI, one worker) are reported, never enforced. Read by src/budget-reporter.ts: report-only, except with COMPILER_TEST_BUDGETS=strict on a quiet machine.
